def test_catalogue_endpoints():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags_data = resp.json()
    assert "tags" in tags_data

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    catalogue = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(catalogue, list)
    assert len(catalogue) > 0

    item_id = catalogue[0]["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item_data = resp.json()
    assert item_data["id"] == item_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/invalid-item-id"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/size"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    size_data = resp.json()
    assert "size" in size_data

def test_shipping_http_workflow():
    order_id = f"order_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    shipping_req = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",
            "country": "UK",
            "number": "10",
            "postcode": "EC1A 1BB",
            "street": "Main St"
        },
        "itemCount": 5,
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("shipping-http", "/shipping"), json=shipping_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment_data = resp.json()
    assert shipment_data["orderId"] == order_id
    assert "trackingNumber" in shipment_data

    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_shipment = resp.json()
    assert fetched_shipment["orderId"] == order_id
    assert fetched_shipment["trackingNumber"] == shipment_data["trackingNumber"]

def test_carts_add_get_update_delete():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    cat_resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert cat_resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {cat_resp.status_code}: {cat_resp.text}"
    catalogue = cat_resp.json()
    assert len(catalogue) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item_id = catalogue[0]["id"]
    unit_price = catalogue[0]["price"]

    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    added_item = resp.json()
    assert added_item["itemId"] == item_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 1

    item_data["quantity"] = 3
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    updated_item = resp.json()
    assert updated_item["quantity"] == 3

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_merge():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    cat_resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert cat_resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {cat_resp.status_code}: {cat_resp.text}"
    catalogue = cat_resp.json()
    assert len(catalogue) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item_id = catalogue[0]["id"]

    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 10.0
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    bad_session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={bad_session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_user_registration_and_auth():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "SecurePassword123!"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "WrongPassword!"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/customers"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
